_about: Maker showcase cards (founder approval, 4 Nov 2026). One entry per Discovery; each card points at an existing PlotNua supplier showcase (supplier-preview-system/showcases/<slug>/showcase.json) and reuses one of that showcase's own approved photographs. Built into the page by atlas-tools/build-showcase-cards.py. To add a showcase: add a card here and rebuild.

cards.description: A Co. Clare landscaping company with five garden rooms in the products below, shown alongside the gardens it has built.
Insulated steel-clad garden rooms from Dublin: the QC6, the QCB garden office and an L-shaped living annex.
One steel-framed, factory-finished design, from a garden room to a four-bedroom home, at one published rate per square metre.

discovery-living-in-the-garden.html.note: Three makers with a full page on PlotNua: photographs, models and what to ask.

cards.description: Saunas and ice baths, supplied and installed from Dublin.
An Irish installer of aluminium pergolas, verandas, porches and glass enclosures, with photographs, published starting prices and what to ask.
